pos.personaBrief: Trapattoni's catenaccio built on devastating counter-attacks and searching for space rather than owning the ball; the 1982-86 Platini phase was more attacking but still space-based.

pro.personaBrief: Counter-attacking catenaccio, quick finishing after recovery (Lecce 1986 counter), safe and system-first play, with Platini's creativity; not a long-ball team but not rondo build-up.

est.personaBrief: System over individuals, a defined defensive bedrock (Zoff, Gentile, Scirea, Cabrini) and zona mista; fixed roles, with Cabrini as an added winger on the flank.

lar.personaBrief: Tardelli, Platini and Boniek centrally, Cabrini as an extra winger and creating space on the wing and edge of the box per TFT; mixed, slightly central.

blo.personaBrief: Catenaccio and a solid defensive foundation; the defence withdrew to protect leads (Lecce 1986), forwards saved energy for attack, no pressing evidence.

mar.personaBrief: Man-marking as religion with zona mista; Gentile man-marked the fantasista, so individual marking dominated.

pla.personaBrief: A system-first coach who imposed his model and kept it, but with specific man-marking assignments against the opponent's star and caution against stronger sides.

res.personaBrief: Maximising chances of success, calcio all'italiana, sacrificed the scudetto for the European Cup, tightened the defence when ahead.

sis.personaBrief: Philosophy stressing the system over individuals, refused to overload the lineup with flair players, sacrificed Brady; stars had defined roles.

jog.personaBrief: Tough, uncompromising Italian game, man-markers like Gentile and runners like Bonini, but technical stars like Platini and Boniek also had a place.

bas.personaBrief: Core of Italian internationals and World Cup winners, veterans and senators winning titles; signings like Platini and Boniek preferred, no academy emphasis.

lid.personaBrief: Trapattoni as the leader in the dugout with a demanding system, players free only to do what he says; tutelage of Platini but equal rules.
